tests.prompt:
Create ONE landscape16:9 finished illustrated story frame. IMAGE1 IS THE USER-APPROVED ODDLY FICTIONAL LIVES DRAWING STYLE REFERENCE. Match its illustrated technique: bold clean black outer contours, thinner interior lines, matte controlled colours, clear readable staging, simple clothing shadows, restrained painted architecture, strong silhouettes. Match its balance of character simplicity and detailed-but-subordinate setting. Never copy Jabba, the employee, his tray/coin, the sandstone palace, drapes, composition or warm palette into the new scene. This is a different universe. No logo, text, watermark, collage, duplicate character, motion blur, excessive texture, 3D rendering, photographic face or skin. Characters and actions must read easily on a phone. Large characters, useful framing, no wasted ceiling or floor. Avoid generic standing cast lineup: one specific interaction. SETTING HALO, THE COVENANT. An original stylised Covenant Elite officer on LEFT wearing recognisable cobalt-blue segmented alien armour over a charcoal bodysuit, angular shoulder guards, elbow/knee plates and blue open-face helmet. Retain Sangheili alien anatomy in simplified cartoon form: tall digitigrade two-legged silhouette, brown-grey alien skin, split four-mandible lower jaw visible below helmet, small eyes under brow. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs. Large expressive alien head proportional to the reference's stylisation, no human nose/hair/beard, not a Space Marine, not Master Chief or an armoured human with a beard. IMPORTANT: this character is an ALIEN, so do not attach our white human head to it. The channel's round-white-head treatment applies to actual humans, while recognisable aliens keep their natural species silhouette.
On RIGHT a distinct much shorter round-bodied Grunt in an orange environmental harness, dark grey breathing mask, one compact triangular methane tank visibly strapped to the back with real connected straps, short thick legs and brown-grey alien hands. The tank is an intentional functional species equipment, not a floating backpack. Exactly ONE Elite and ONE Grunt. The Elite calmly points to a waist-high rectangular supply crate between them. The Grunt struggles to lift it with BOTH hands, knees bent, mask tilted toward the officer; physical comedy and obvious difference in authority. No firearms, fight, injury, prison or human captives. A normal supply-duty moment in an alien military.
Interior: readable Covenant ship cargo antechamber, curved purple structural ribs, cyan inset lights, ONE tall rounded triangular doorway behind Grunt, simple dark metal floor. One additional small crate stack back-left, no fake holographic text. Same matte2D drawing language as image1, appropriate cool violet/cobalt/teal palette with orange accent, face/body of aliens never pure white. Medium-wide frame with both whole silhouettes and central crate visible. Both feet/legs grounded, no floating equipment. Keep architecture coherent, no hall-of-mirrors depth. This is a visual style test, no claim of a specific canon event.

observations: Primary actually viewed generated full frame: one tall blue-armoured alien officer pointing at one crate, one short orange-harness masked alien trying to lift it; no duplicated people or unintended white human heads.
Recognisable alien military palette and curved purple/cyan cargo architecture, matte outlined drawing, original scene rather than copied Jabba palace.
Equipment visibly attached, clear crate-lifting interaction, no weapons or injuries.
limits: Species anatomy and armour details remain a proposal to verify against franchise references before canonical named-cast sheets.
No consecutive shot/location continuity test performed.

He braces the removable blue pauldron with BOTH hands, about to fit it onto the marine's exposed LEFT shoulder socket, visibly checking its size. One large blue power-armoured marine, one red-robed apron-wearing armourer fitting a blue shoulder plate; one spare helmet on shelf.
Readable grey gothic armoury, amber window, equipment interaction; no realistic human face or stretched long-legged body.
